why_a_separate_artifact_not_a_tci_patch: The Ω1 TCI (TOTAL_CONCEPT_INVENTORY_v1_0.json) is owned and independently verified on branch elev/gamma-Omega-tci and does NOT exist on this lane's branch (elev/gamma-Omega-mechanisms, off elev/gamma). Editing it here would either be impossible (file absent) or create a divergent copy that collides at reconciliation. A separate additive coverage artifact (a) does not touch another lane's verified deliverable, (b) precisely records live-confirmed-vs-gap per charter item AFTER the C6 fix — the exact Ω6 mandate — and (c) carries the cross-manifest reconciliation notes for the RECONCILE pass to fold into the TCI without me pre-empting it. The TCI's 10 mechanism_class entries and asset.bo_yantra_mechanism entry are already present and correct in kind; this artifact confirms their live serving status and flags two row_count semantics notes below.

ALL 11 charter Ω6 structures are live-served and queryable. Every structure named in the Ω6 spec resolves to a working MCP surface returning real data on the run chart (or an honest, contract-correct empty).

cross_manifest_notes.disposition: PARKED-HONEST (for Ω1 TCI / RECONCILE pass; NOT a data bug, NOT fixed by this lane)
cross_manifest_notes.title: TCI mechanism-class row_count_per_canonical_chart is summed across all 5 ayanamshas; served tool defaults to one
cross_manifest_notes.detail: For every materialized mechanism class, the TCI row_count_per_canonical_chart is exactly 5x the count bodha_mechanisms_get returns by default. Verified: convergent_dispositor_chain TCI=5 / served-lahiri=1 / db-all-ayanamshas=5; mutual_aspect 180/36/180; mutual_aspect_triangle 420/84/420; graha_bhava_affliction 10/2/10 (n_ayanamshas=5). The TCI number is the multi-ayanamsha total; the served facet is per-ayanamsha (default lahiri_chitrapaksha). A naive consumer who reads the TCI count and then calls the tool will see 1/5 of the expected rows and could mis-read it as under-serving. Suggested reconcile action: annotate mechanism-class TCI entries with is_ayanamsha_summed:true (or split per-ayanamsha), mirroring the entry_schema's existing is_ayanamsha_variant flag.
cross_manifest_notes.not_my_manifest: bodha_mechanisms_get default ayanamsha behavior is α's serving surface (query_mechanisms.ts / register_p1_aliases.ts) and is contract-correct per C6; the TCI row_count semantics are Ω1/β's. Reported, not touched.
